extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed Adobe Remote Update Manager build version, or "Not installed".
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Adobe Remote Update Manager Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe)
rum="/usr/local/bin/RemoteUpdateManager"
if [[ -x "$rum" ]]; then version=$("$rum" -h 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk -F': *' '/BuildVersion/ { print $2; exit }') echo "<result>${version:-Unknown}</result>" elif [[ -f "/usr/sbin/RemoteUpdateManager" ]]; then echo "<result>Pre 2015.5 Release</result>" else echo "<result>Not installed</result>" fi
